text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you come all the way out here just 
to pick me up? You really have too much 
free time on your hands."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Rest assured, even though I lost the 
Derby crown."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"My Classic year isn't over yet. If I can 
just deliver results in the upcoming 
Kikuka-sho—"
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to take it?
Aren't you going to take it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. I'm just choosing not to 
take it—
(Slip...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Shoot... I'm falling...!
(Clack...)

text_block_list.name: Telephone
text_block_list.text: "...Hello? Hello?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why did the call have to connect 
right now...?!

text_block_list.name: Telephone
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, if you're there, why don't you 
answer? King?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Good day, Mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah, she finally replied. Honestly, 
what a child."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Don't just treat me like a child.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...There are times when the situation 
makes it difficult to answer, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""Right. She ran in the Derby, after all. 
Now that you mention it, that was quite 
something—""

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—Special Week-san. It has been a long 
time since I last saw a performance that 
captivated people so deeply."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"It's such a shame that she's your 
opponent. Didn't you feel like just giving 
up?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I suggest you come home before you 
embarrass yourself any further."
(*Click*... *beep beep*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Who do you think you are, acting all 
high and mighty?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Calling me out of nowhere, calling me 
pathetic, telling me to give up... Just 
saying whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Pathetic"? "Give up"? What makes you say 
that?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Words like that are wholly and utterly 
unfitting for a first-rate King like me!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Listen to me!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely win the upcoming Kikuka 
Sho!! I won't let anyone else have first 
place!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Not to Seiun Sky-san, and not to Special 
Week-san! I won't lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I am King Halo!! I'm a first-rate 
Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume who deserves to be 
recognized...!
